properties.name: inertia.root-template
properties.description: Name of the root HTML template resolved from the classpath under templates/.

properties.name: inertia.ssr-url
properties.description: URL of the SSR server endpoint.

properties.name: inertia.version-strategy
properties.description: Asset version strategy: sha256 (default) or vite-manifest.

properties.name: inertia.version-custom
properties.description: Fixed asset version; when set it wins over the strategy.

properties.name: inertia.encrypt-history
properties.description: Whether the client must encrypt history state.

properties.name: inertia.camelize-props
properties.description: Whether prop keys are converted from camelCase to snake_case.

properties.name: inertia.csrf-enabled
properties.description: Whether the XSRF-TOKEN cookie synchronization is active.

properties.name: inertia.flash-keys
properties.description: Additional session keys that must be flashed with every page.

properties.name: inertia.always-include-errors
properties.description: Whether validation errors are always injected into the props.

properties.name: inertia.error-status
properties.description: HTTP status used for error pages.

properties.name: inertia.lazy-etag-enabled
properties.description: Whether the ETag / 304 handling is active.

properties.name: inertia.root-view
properties.description: Optional explicit view name (template) for the root view.
